$comment: The lifecycle transition table — plan item 3.1. THE FORMAT IS THE AUTHORITY.
AF3 §4.3, following RC3: 'the lock became a TypeScript implementation detail
rather than a property of the on-disk format. There was never one owner of the
on-disk format - only of the schemas.' Three languages read this state (Python
harness, TS MCP server, JS hooks), and hooks/session-end.mjs is a confirmed
third-language writer of mission-state.json. An FSM implemented in Python is
invisible to stop.mjs, which is the component whose wrong predicate caused
C-02 - implementing it in one language and letting the others re-derive is the
.tree.lock mistake verbatim.
So the table is DATA, versioned and diffable, and each language ships a small
reader over it. Deliberately not python-statemachine: class syntax that
stop.mjs and state.ts cannot read structurally recreates RC3.
ENFORCEMENT is the MCP write path only (single writer). Hooks are READERS -
they ask 'is this state terminal / stale?' rather than hard-coding it. AF3
risk 2: stop.mjs has five deliberate fail-open catches, so a guard evaluated
in a hook is a suggestion. Guards are enforced at the writer, advisory at the
readers, and saying so here is what keeps the two from drifting.
max_dwell_s is item 3.3. It gives the system the predicate it never had -
'is this still alive?' becomes now - entered_at > max_dwell_s, computable by
any reader in any language from the file alone, with no event. null means a
state may be occupied indefinitely.
Item 0.7 lives here. `paused` had an edge in and no edge out, and
stop.mjs exits 0 on it - so ONE session ending disabled the drift
guard for the rest of the mission's life. The mission stayed
technically alive and completely ungoverned. Both resume edges are
asserted in mcp/tests/pause-recovery-edge.test.ts; if Phase 3 rebuilt
the machine without them the Phase 0 fix would be silently dropped.

initialized.$comment: 1.4: what a run reports before it has recorded anything, including when its state file is missing or unreadable. There is deliberately no state meaning 'probably running'.

running.$comment: K-09: the final r3 tick sat here, at step 9, for hours. max_dwell_s is what makes that observable from the file alone.

blocked.$comment: Item 2b.3. Naming the wait is ours; blocking is a host affordance. A tick waiting on something it does not own was previously indistinguishable from one making progress.
